name: STARBOX COFFEE: Coffee Rising
description: CLIMB. COLLECT. BREW. Enter the original STARBOX coffeehouse and escape a giant transparent cup as coffee rises below. Jump around a true cylindrical spiral, collect your recipe, and race for a Perfect Coffee.
